args.summary: 西红柿炒蛋 is plated, following Wang Gang's steps. 1) Prep: 2 tomatoes cut into 300 g of wedges; cups of oil, salt and sugar; drum loaded with ketchup 5 g, water 60 g, starch water 25 g and finishing oil 5 g. 2) 润锅: 40 g oil heated to about 157 °C, then poured out. 3) Eggs: 25 g fresh oil cooled to about 127 °C with the heat off. The 150 g beaten egg went in and fried undisturbed for 50 s on low heat (0.3), was flipped, fried 30 s on the second side, then went into the holding bowl. 4) Tomato: fried 45 s on low heat, ketchup 5 g stirred in. 5) Water 60 g, salt 1 g and sugar 1 g added, then simmered about 50 s at medium heat until the tomato was soft. 6) Starch water 25 g stirred in to thicken, then the 5 g splash of finishing oil (明油). 7) Eggs returned and tossed briefly, then plated. The highest reading was 174 °C, just after the oil was poured out; the smoke detector never went off. One gap: the drum's limit was 60 g, so the water was 60 g rather than the planned 100 g.

decision.expect: The dish ends: tomato and egg on the plate in a glossy, thickened sauce, and the wok rinsed and back on the cooker.
